generic_name: Damiana, Galium Aparine, Glandula Suprarenalis Bovinum, Hepar Bovinum, Korean Ginseng, Nuphar Luteum, Orchitinum Bovinum, Phosphoricum Acidum, Pituitary Bovinum, Populus Tremuloides, Testosterone (Combination Homeopathic Formula)
drug_class: Homeopathic / Natural Health Product — Adaptogenic and Hormonal Support Combination
purpose: This combination product is typically used to support male vitality, energy levels, and general hormonal balance. It is often marketed to help with fatigue, low libido, and overall physical and mental stamina. Some ingredients are also used to support liver function and adrenal health.
how_it_works: This product combines plant extracts, animal-derived glandular tissues, and homeopathic dilutions that are believed to gently support your body's own hormonal and energy systems. Ingredients like Korean Ginseng are thought to help your body handle stress better, while glandular ingredients like Orchitinum and Pituitary Bovinum are believed in homeopathy to send gentle signals to support similar glands in your own body. It is important to know that scientific evidence for homeopathic ingredients is limited, and effects may vary from person to person.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this product well. Mild digestive upset such as nausea or stomach discomfort is possible. Some people may notice mild headaches, especially when first starting. Korean Ginseng may occasionally cause insomnia or restlessness if taken too late in the day.
warnings: Do not use this product if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without speaking to your doctor first. If you have hormone-sensitive conditions such as prostate issues, breast concerns, or any cancer, talk to your doctor before using this product because it contains testosterone-related ingredients. Do not use if you are already on hormone replacement therapy without medical guidance. This product is not a substitute for prescribed medications. Always tell your doctor and pharmacist about all supplements you are taking to avoid interactions.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies by brand and formulation. Typically, adults take 1 to 2 tablets or the recommended number of drops 2 to 3 times daily, preferably away from meals. Always follow the label instructions on your specific product, and check with your pharmacist or healthcare provider if you are unsure about the right dose for you.
